text.p: PRAVDA - The opposition Party of the Democratic Left (SDL) said it would propose an amendment to the law on privatisation allowing the re-privatisation of state firms in cases of sale of state property at below their value.
- The SDL demands that citizens over 65-years-old should get their privatisation bonds paid out before the maturity date in the year 2001.
- The SDL said the National Property Fund (NPF), the state privatisation agency, will not be able to collect the 35-40 billion crowns needed to redeem the privatisation bonds.

NARODNA OBRODA - The Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) posted a turnover of over 80 billion crowns in the first nine months of this year, compared with turnover of around 40 billion for the whole of 1995.

- Slovakia's largest celullose and paper producer, SCP Ruzomberok, held an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on Wednesday following the privatisation of 67 percent of the firm to little-known Eco-Invest. The meeting approved changes to the company's statutes and to its board of directors and supervisory board, but no details were disclosed.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Bramac Dachsysteme International - Poechlarn, will open a new plant for the production of roofing materials in Nitra, western Slovakia, in April 1997, with an investment of 500 million crowns.
- Intrans a.s., a cargo company specialised in combined transport, has launched a regular railway cargo route between Slovakia and Russia.
- U.S.-based Kimberly-Clark Corporation is to open a Slovak subsidiary which will export its total production to western Europe.
SME - Both President Michal Kovac and Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar are expected to attend the congress of the Confederation of Trade Unions this weekend.
